results.description:
Foot Size Check measures feet with nothing but a sheet of Letter or A4 paper and a photo.

Keep track of foot size over time. Place a foot on Letter or A4 paper, trace around it with a pen, and photograph the sheet. The app reads the outline and measures foot length, width, and a suggested shoe size automatically. No points to line up by hand. The outline is kept at true size.

Features:
- Foot measurement on Letter or A4 paper (length and width)
- Automatic measurement: the traced line is read, heel, toe, and width points are placed for you, and length and width are calculated (you can still adjust by hand)
- Foot outline: the traced line is saved as a true-size shape
- Foot outline card: send it to family right after saving
- Suggested shoe size — a label-size guide: foot length plus 0.5–1.0 cm. This is separate from the inside length measured using an insole
- EU, US and UK conversion in the record detail, and the shoe size shown in your own notation (choose JP, EU, US or UK in Settings)
- Shoe size chart: compare foot length with EU, US and UK sizes across different size categories
- Growth history saved over time
- Track left and right feet separately
- Fine-tune measurement points by hand
- Growth card: share the latest length, outline, and chart as one image with family
- Insole measuring: trace and photograph a shoe's insole to see the current toe room (about 10 mm is a general guide, per the Japanese Society for Foot Care and Podiatric Medicine)
- How to fit shoes: checks for choosing shoes, based on podiatry society guidance
- My size book: automatically keeps the size that fits each brand, from your shoe notes
- Measurement reminder: at an interval that matches the age (every 3 months up to age 3, 4 months to age 6, 6 months from age 7; guidance from the Japanese Society for Foot Care and Podiatric Medicine)
- Birthday messages: add a birth date and get one quiet greeting that morning
- No account or banner ads. Photo analysis and measurement happen on your device. The developer cannot read your data
- iCloud sync is free and optional. Only when you enable it are records and photos saved in your private iCloud storage, available on your other devices and after a new phone or reinstall. The developer cannot access them.

Foot Size Check Pro (optional one-time purchase):
- Same-age reference band on the growth chart (by sex; published survey data from Japan, Spain, or China)
- Shoe replacement estimate: about how many months until the current shoes get too small
- Register more than one name for family records (one is free)
- Add a second shoe note and beyond (one is free)
- See the growth chart for the whole "All" span
- Remove the Foot Size Check label from growth cards
- A notification when the toe room is likely down to about 5 mm, and an estimate of the toe room in 3 months
- Show in store: one person’s shoe size in extra-large text, filling the screen
- Measuring, records, the growth chart, foot outlines, reminders, and birthday messages are free. Not a subscription

Note: results are estimates only. Shoe fit varies by brand, model, and foot shape. We recommend trying shoes on in store before buying.

Look back at foot photos, outlines and sizes in date order. Outlines share the same scale, and you can overlay two records of the same foot to see how it has grown. Optional foot and profile photos are available across your devices when iCloud sync is enabled.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

results.description:
Laundry Tap reminds you when the wash is done and keeps track of when you last did the laundry.

Start a wash or dry timer, put your phone away, and get a notification when the cycle ends. The countdown stays on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. When the clothes are hung up, tap once to log today's laundry. Home then shows how many days it's been since your last wash, and when it's about time again.

■ How it works
1. Tap "Wash 45 min" or "Dry 60 min" (you choose the length)
2. Get a notification when it's done
3. Tap "Hung up" — today's laundry is logged

■ Features
- Wash and dry timers, 5 to 180 minutes. Your last length is remembered
- Live Activity countdown on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
- Log today's laundry right from the notification
- "Days since last wash" and a gentle status, based on how often you like to wash (every 1–7 days)
- Monthly calendar of your laundry days. Tap any day to add or remove it
- Up to 5 reminders, each with its own time: every day, weekdays, weekends, or the days you pick. It can stay quiet on days you've already washed
- Log your laundry with Shortcuts and Siri, without opening the app

■ Private by design
- No account, no ads, no in-app purchases
- Everything stays on your iPhone. Nothing is sent to a server

■ Good to know
- Laundry Tap doesn't connect to your washing machine. The timer uses the length you set
- It doesn't handle laundromat payments or weather forecasts

Add Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, log from Control Center, or put the “Mark Laundry Washed” control on Apple Watch with watchOS 26.

Available in 25 languages.

results.description:
PoopTap is a one-tap poop tracker with no ads and no account. Every log lands on a private calendar on your device — and feeds a weird little poop buddy that grows, evolves, and slowly develops opinions about your gut habits.

Tap once after you go. That's the whole workflow. Your log lands on a private calendar, your streak grows, and your poop evolves through stages — from Tiny Poop all the way to Legendary. The Throne Keeper watches over your record and comments on your progress, whether you asked or not.

Under the humor is a genuinely useful bowel movement log: shape and color details, optional symptom marks, a short note per entry, a monthly calendar view, and optional reminders when your record goes quiet. A home and lock screen widget lets you log without opening the app.

Supports the large inner display on iPhone Duo.

Progress is designed to reward consistency, not spam: only a limited daily growth bonus counts toward evolution.

Your logs stay on your device. No accounts, no ads, no analytics. If you turn on Apple Health linking, PoopTap writes only the constipation, diarrhea, and bloating marks you choose; it does not infer symptoms or read Health data. PoopTap is for personal tracking and entertainment — it is not a medical app and does not provide health advice.

Backup (free): export a copy of your logs and settings, choose where to save it using the share sheet, and restore it by selecting the backup in Files.

PoopTap Plus is available to new customers as a monthly or yearly subscription. It unlocks extra evolution forms, premium trivia, extra achievements, premium share cards, Annoying reminder mode, themes, and discreet app icons. If you previously bought Plus as a one-time purchase, you keep access to every Plus feature.

results.releaseNotes:
Give your little buddy more forms, colors, and oddball charm. PoopTap Plus now offers monthly and yearly plans with premium evolutions, themes, trivia, share cards, and more.
Plus owners no longer see purchase prompts, and restored backups bring achievements back too.

results.description:
Big Text Note shows one note in large, easy-to-read text so you can hold it up to the person in front of you.

It works as a simple communication board: for talking with someone who is deaf or hard of hearing, for the days when your own voice is not available, for noisy places like stations and event halls, or for a quick word at a counter or reception desk. Type it, show it, and if needed, let the device say it.

Read Aloud speaks the note with the voices built into your iPhone or iPad. The language is detected from the text, and nothing is sent to a server.

Voice input turns what the other person says into text on the device and writes it straight onto the board in big letters. Tap the mic to start and the red stop button to finish. Audio is never saved; only the text on the board is stored.

Show mode turns the note into a clear message board. Pick Normal, Large, or Huge, fine-tune the size, and choose text and background colors, including high-contrast pairs. Flip the note upside down for the person across the table, or turn your iPhone sideways for one long line. The screen stays on while Show mode is open. Quick Phrases keeps four ready-made lines and up to 20 of your own, one tap away. Reorder your phrases whenever you like.

Add the Home Screen widget to keep the current note in view. No account, no ads, no tracking, and no server sync. The note stays on your device.

Write to talk, flip for the person across, or open straight from the Lock Screen and Control Center.

On iPhone Duo’s larger display, write on the left and show an automatically enlarged message on the right.

Big Text Note Pro
Translate your note on this device with Pro (iOS 18 or later).
Show the translation to the person opposite you.
iOS may ask to download language data the first time. An internet connection is needed for the download.
Writing, showing, speech, phrases and widgets stay free.
Eligible new yearly subscribers get a one-week free trial. Monthly subscriptions have no free trial.
Billed monthly. Renews automatically. Cancel anytime.
Billed yearly. Renews automatically. Cancel anytime.

results.description:
Photos and videos, sized for uploads
Prepare videos as well as photos in the same workspace. Choose a video limit of 10, 25, 50 or 100 MB, or enter a custom limit from 1 to 1000 MB. Video compression keeps the audio and saves a new copy without changing the original. Processing stays on your device. Check the actual file size, resolution and duration before saving to Photos or Files or sharing. One video at a time is free; Pro includes batch processing. If a video is too long for the chosen limit, choose a larger limit.

Prepare photos for forms and uploads by adjusting their file size, pixel dimensions, and crop. Choose a HEIC, PNG, or JPG photo, set your requirements, and check the finished JPG. HEIC and PNG photos are saved as new JPG copies; your originals stay unchanged.

Set a file size limit
Choose 200KB, 500KB, 1MB, 2MB, or 4MB, or enter a custom limit. Photo Resize adjusts JPEG quality and, when needed, reduces pixel dimensions to stay within the limit. The result shows its actual file size and pixel dimensions before you save.

Choose dimensions and crop
Keep the current dimensions, set the long edge in pixels, or specify width and height. Crop freely or use 1:1, 3:4, 4:3, 16:9, or the ratio of your specified dimensions. Pinch and drag to position the photo. If meeting the file size limit requires smaller dimensions, check the final pixels shown in the result.

Save and share
Export as JPG to Photos or Files, share it, or drag the JPG into another app. Your original photo stays unchanged. Photos are processed on your device and are not sent to a server. Location information is removed, while the capture date is kept. You can also remove the capture date in Settings.

Free features
Process one photo at a time with all file size, dimension, crop, JPG export, save, and share features. Save one named preset for settings you use often. There are no ads.

Photo Resize Pro
Process multiple photos with the same settings and save more than one preset. Pro is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription. Check the purchase screen for prices, billing periods, and any available trial terms. You can cancel through App Store subscription management.

Upload requirements vary. Check the final file size and dimensions against the receiving service's requirements. Photo Resize does not check identity-photo rules such as face size.

results.description:
DailyAlbum keeps one photo a day and hangs it in a frame. A spare iPhone or iPad, or your TV, becomes the frame that shows today's photo.

Use it for everyday moments, your own life, trips, plants, creative work, pets, family, or any small change worth remembering. Open a date, choose one meaningful photo, and let your saved days fill in — no photo editing or social feeds getting in the way. Empty days can even fill themselves: DailyAlbum quietly suggests one good photo — favoring people and pets, skipping screenshots and document shots — all on your device.

◆ Display it
Frame Mode shows today's photo full screen with its date and note. Stand up an iPad or an old iPhone and it becomes a photo frame for your room. At the start of each month, replay last month as a monthly album. Turn iPhone Duo sideways and open it to see a full month on the left and the selected day's photos on the right across its wide screen.

◆ Never lose it
Turn on iCloud Sync (free, optional) and your photo choices and notes are stored in your personal iCloud, so they survive a new phone or a reinstall. Notes hold up to 300 characters, and you can search them to find that day again in seconds.

◆ Revisit and share
Add the widget to meet a saved moment on your home screen, and get a gentle note when a photo from this day in past years exists. Turn any day into a beautiful card — photo, date, and note — to share in messages or social apps. Save and share your monthly recap as a vertical video, for free.

◆ Privacy
No account is required. By default DailyAlbum shows photos straight from your photo library and doesn't upload them. With iCloud Sync on, your choices and notes are stored in your personal iCloud. If you turn on photo sync or share with family, a copy of just those photos is kept in your own iCloud too — never on the developer's servers, and never readable by the developer.

◆ DailyAlbum Premium
One subscription for your own album. It includes Archive, unlimited Frame Mode, unlimited monthly album replays, photo copy sync, year images and extra designs. As another Premium benefit, invited family can view one shared photo per day in DailyAlbum; you choose all days or only a selected tag, and viewing is always free. The calendar, photo choices, notes and iCloud sync for choices and notes stay free.

Plus is no longer sold. If you already own it, all your Plus benefits stay yours permanently. New Premium benefits require a subscription.

The paid DailyAlbum Premium plan is an auto-renewing subscription (monthly or yearly). Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, and the subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings. Viewing is always free for invited family.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://zec-inc.jp/privacy

results.description:
Study with a chill buddy that grows and talks on tap.
Pair with a friend, too. No rankings.

Tap "Start studying", then "Finish studying". No setup. The timer keeps running even if you close the app, and you can pause anytime.
Every minute you study helps your buddy grow and level up. Taking a break won't shrink your buddy.

Time your study without opening the app
- While the timer runs, the elapsed time and your buddy appear on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with a ring that fills as you study
- Start and stop from your Home Screen widget
- Start and stop from Control Center or the Action button (iOS 18 or later)
- Hold your iPhone to an NFC tag on your desk to start or stop (Shortcuts), or let a Focus do it
- Forgot to stop? After 3 hours you get one reminder, and you can adjust the end time later

Plan what to study today
- Study plans: list what to study today, then tap "Study this" to pick it and its subject before you start
- Paste a study plan made with AI or anywhere else to add many plans at once
- Pick events from your calendar, or connect a Reminders list
- Unfinished plans carry over to the next day. After 7 days, they move to "Someday"

Ambient sounds while you study
- Light rain outside, forest leaves, pencil on paper, and a quiet library. Sounds unlock as your buddy levels up
- They mix with music from other apps and fade out when you pause or take a break

Keep going
- Pomodoro: 25 minutes of focus, 5 of rest. Change the times anytime
- Daily study time goal: set a goal in minutes and see how much is left
- Current goal: write what you're working toward in one line
- Exam countdown: see the days left on the home screen and widgets, with reminders before the exam
- Summary card: after you stop, see the EXP you earned, today's total, and your streak
- Share today's study as a single image
- Focus rating: mark each session "Not great", "OK", or "Great" (optional)
- Study calendar: days you reach your goal get a leaf
- Weekly review: at the end of each week, look back at your total and the subject you studied most
- Study tips: 12 ideas backed by research

See what you studied, and how much
- Choose a subject when you finish
- Forgot the timer? Add records up to 30 days back
- Weekly and monthly charts show time and share by subject
- Add textbooks and workbooks to see your time by material
- Fix the time, subject, note, or focus rating of any record later
- Export your records as CSV
- iCloud sync and backup: switch iPhones and get your sessions and buddy back by turning on sync with the same Apple ID

Study Pair (Study Buddy Premium)
Connect with one partner using a join code, valid for 24 hours and one use. See today’s totals and study status. Grow a buddy together. A supporter can take part with one cheer a day. Subjects and notes stay private. Creating a pair needs Premium; joining and new codes for an existing pair are free.

Study Buddy Premium
Premium lets you choose a fixed study spot, including a year-round Christmas room. The regular window changes with the hour for free.

Monthly or yearly auto-renewing plans: Apple Watch timer, past charts and calendars, pair creation, 2 extra sounds, up to 5 exams. Timer, records, buddy and iCloud sync stay free. Pro owners keep all benefits for life; restore without subscribing. Cancel in subscription settings.

No ads. Your records are yours
Personal records stay on your iPhone, with optional private iCloud sync. Code pairs separately save display names, buddy details, study status and the last 14 days of study totals and cheers in Apple’s app storage. The developer and anyone with the room ID can read them. Leaving deletes your shared data. Ending a pair deletes the room, code and creator’s data; partner data is deleted when their app reconnects. Existing link pairs keep their private iCloud sharing.

results.description:
Caffeine Tap helps you keep a daily caffeine log during pregnancy and breastfeeding. See today's total and how much is left before the daily guide you have chosen.

Start by choosing pregnant, breastfeeding, or neither. For pregnancy and breastfeeding, the app sets a guide for your region and shows the organization behind it. Guides vary by country and organization: EFSA uses 200 mg a day, while Health Canada uses 300 mg. You can change your guide. Choose neither to use your own daily guide.

Log a drink with one tap using presets, and adjust the caffeine amount for each of up to 12 presets. Record half a cup, one and a half cups, or two cups, set the time you drank it, and edit or undo an entry. Amounts are standard estimates and vary by product and brewing method.

Review your 7-day and 30-day averages, days above your guide, and your most logged drinks. Browse daily entries in the calendar.

Check today's intake with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets. The small Home Screen widget logs the drink at the top of your preset list. Use Siri and Shortcuts to log caffeine and check your day. Lock Screen widgets are for viewing only. With watchOS 26 or later, log 1 cup from Control Center, the Smart Stack, or the Action button on Apple Watch. No Watch app needed.

Turn on Apple Health in Settings to save the caffeine you log (mg) to Health. Sleep is read only to show two averages side by side: nights after days with late caffeine and other nights. The app does not judge how caffeine affects your sleep. Health data is handled on your device and is never sent anywhere.

No account. No ads. Your data stays on your device. The app does not calculate caffeine remaining in your body, predict sleep, or tell you how long to wait before breastfeeding.

This app is for recording caffeine and displaying reference amounts, not for diagnosis or treatment. If you have concerns, consult a doctor or midwife.
results.releaseNotes: The Home Screen widget is now a ring, so you can see at a glance how far into today's guide you are. Log with one tap from Control Center, the Action button, or Back Tap, and ask Siri how much you've had or how much is left. Choosing pregnant or breastfeeding now shows the daily guide it sets. Thank you for using the app. We read every review you leave.

Check the current air pressure, see whether it is rising, steady, or falling, and save a quick private note about your mood and condition. In History, BaroNote places the available six-hour pressure movement beside your log without judging the cause or making a forecast.

Features:

- Current air pressure from the iPhone pressure sensor when available
- Rising, steady, and falling trend display
- Mood, condition, symptom tags, and optional notes
- History with the available six-hour pressure movement
- Optional Health link for matching condition and mood records
- hPa, mb, inHg, and mmHg units
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
- No account, tracking, ads, or server upload

Your BaroNote records stay on this device. BaroNote is for personal logging only and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or forecasts.

results.description:
Mark your one daily habit done without opening the app—from Home Screen, Lock Screen, Control Center, or Apple Watch.

No task lists. No planning overload. Name your one thing, tap Done once a day, and see your streak and calendar fill up.

DoneToday is designed to be simple:

- One task at a time, one tap to mark it done
- Current streak, best streak, and a monthly calendar
- Home Screen widgets with a Done button and your last 7 days
- Lock Screen widgets and a Control Center toggle (iOS 18)
- Siri and Shortcuts: "Mark done in DoneToday", or check today's status and your streak in automations
- Optional daily reminder that stays quiet once today is done
- Forgot yesterday? Mark it from the calendar or the one-line prompt
- Starting a new task keeps the old one in Past Tasks
- Export a backup file and restore it on a new iPhone
- Add a one-line note after you finish—what you did today, in your own words
- Share this month's calendar as an image, with your notes if you like

No account. No cloud. Your history stays on your device unless you export a backup yourself.

Made by ZEC — simple tools for everyday life.
results.releaseNotes:

results.description:
WaterDone is the lightest way to keep sipping before you get thirsty.

Had a sip? Tap once. That's the whole app.
No amounts to type. No daily target. The goal is a rhythm: another sip within the interval you choose. A little drop dries out as time passes and fills up when you drink, and a gentle word tells you how you're doing — "Hydrated", "Time for a sip".

• One tap from your Lock Screen or Home Screen widget, without opening the app
• See when your next sip is due, right on the home screen
• A gentle nudge before you dry out. You pick the interval (2–4 hours) and the hours it can reach you. Works fine with notifications off, too
• Tapped by mistake? Undo in one tap
• Just ate? Tap “I just ate” and your next nudge moves later (it isn’t counted as a sip)

results.description:
Number Forge is a daily number puzzle. Every day brings one new
puzzle: combine six numbers with + - x / to forge the target number.

HOW TO PLAY
- Pick two tiles and an operation to forge them into a new number.
- Reach the target in as few operations as you can.
- Par shows the minimum possible. Can you match it?

ONE PUZZLE A DAY
- Everyone gets the same puzzle each day.
- Track solved days, your current streak, longest streak, and par matches.
- Share your result as spoiler-free text.

DAILY LEADERBOARD
- Solved today? See where you stand: "Today: #N of M" on the Game Center Daily Forge leaderboard.
- Scores start at 2,000: each move over par costs 200 points and each second costs 1 (time stops counting at 20 minutes).
- Game Center sign-in is optional. Everything works without it.

NOT QUITE THERE? IT STILL COUNTS
- Finish whenever you like: 2 stars within 10 of the target, 1 star within 25. Stars keep your streak going.
- Once you finish, you can see an example solution.

MORE THAN ONE WAY
- After solving, look for other ways to forge the target.
- Every new way raises your title for the day: Apprentice, Smith, Master Smith, Legend.

WIDGET AND REMINDER
- Add a widget to see today's target, or your solved result, at a glance.
- An optional daily reminder helps you keep the habit. The app works
  fully without notifications.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account required. No ads. No tracking.
- Your progress stays on your device.

PREVIOUS PUZZLES AND LANGUAGES
- Finish today’s puzzle to practice earlier dates locally. Practice never affects rankings, streaks, titles, or stats.
- The app and Widget match all 13 App Store localisations.

results.description:
Help Screen SOS is a support app for asking people nearby for help by showing your phone screen when you cannot speak.

The English experience focuses on Silent SOS, personal safety, and travel help. It can show simple high-contrast messages such as “HELP,” “I feel unsafe,” or “I am traveling and need help.” It can also show that you cannot speak, have difficulty speaking, or do not speak the local language.

The app focuses on showing clear SOS text. Alarm sound, vibration, and screen flash are optional support features that start only when the user presses the in-app button.

Main features:
- Full-screen Silent SOS message display
- Situation selection for the SOS message
- Personal safety and travel help messages
- Manual display language selection
- SOS messages in Japanese, English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
- Optional intro text for when you cannot speak, have difficulty speaking, or do not speak the local language
- Optional English message shown together
- Alarm sound on/off
- Vibration on/off
- Screen flash effect on/off
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
- Control Center, Shortcuts, and Action Button friendly actions
- Organized SOS display settings and ZEC Apps settings
- Works fully on device

This app does not replace contacting police, emergency services, station staff, security, or people nearby directly. In an emergency, ask for direct help from public authorities or nearby people.

The app does not record audio, take photos or videos, send location data, or automatically contact emergency services. Display language is selected manually by the user, and the app does not use location-based language detection. Widgets, controls, and Shortcuts do not start the alarm immediately; the alarm starts only after the user presses the in-app start button.

Show polite, natural Japanese to the person in front of you. Staff point to an answer. You tap it, and the card turns around to show the answer in your language.

Travel apps that translate are great until the waiter can't read your screen, the station is noisy, or you have no signal. Japanese Phrase Cards does something simpler: it shows checked Japanese in large type, and gives staff ready-made answers to point to.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick a phrase, such as "Could I have the bill, please?"
2. Show the screen. Under the Japanese, staff see answers in Japanese: "Please pay at the register", "Please pay at your table".
3. Staff point to an answer; you tap it. The card turns around and shows the answer in your language.
For prices, minutes, platforms and exits, staff point to or say the number. You enter it on the keypad: 3,480円 becomes ¥3,480 for you.

WRITTEN BY A NATIVE SPEAKER
Every Japanese sentence was written and checked by a native Japanese speaker, in polite wording that staff at restaurants, stations, hotels and pharmacies read at a glance. Where a question could seem odd, a short line tells staff why you are asking ("I'm asking because I can't eat fish").

YOUR OWN CARDS
• Allergy card: choose from the allergens used in Japan's food labeling system (wheat, buckwheat, egg, milk, peanut, shrimp, crab, walnut, cashew and more), how serious it is, and vegetarian, vegan, halal or no-alcohol needs. The app builds the Japanese from fixed, checked sentences.
• Health card: conditions, medicines, drug allergies and an emergency contact.
• Hotel card: paste the Japanese address and show it to a taxi driver.
Everything stays on your phone.

10 SCENES, 137 PHRASES
Eating out · Allergies & diet · Paying & shopping · Trains & stations · Taxi · Hotel & hot springs · Health & pharmacy · Asking the way · Photos · Emergencies

MADE FOR SHOWING
• Full-screen card with maximum brightness, and the screen stays on
• Turn your phone sideways for even bigger text
• Play the Japanese aloud, or slowly
• Phrase cards work offline. No account. No data collected.
• On supported devices, translate spoken replies on the device. Translation languages may need a download first.

FREE AND ONE-TIME PURCHASE
Allergy, health and emergency phrases are always free, along with the first phrases in every scene and one card of each kind. A one-time purchase (not a subscription) unlocks every phrase and as many cards as you need.

The app helps you ask clearly; it does not guarantee that food is free of an ingredient. For a severe allergy, follow your doctor's advice. In an emergency in Japan, call 119 (ambulance, fire) or 110 (police).
